# Node.js Standards

**← Back to [EAP Home](../../../README.md) • [Enterprise Standards](../../README.md) • [Technology Standards](../README.md)**

---

> This directory contains Node.js-specific standards for enterprise backend development at Gainwell Technologies. These standards provide comprehensive guidance for building secure, maintainable Node.js microservices and Backend-for-Frontend (BFF) services using TypeScript, covering security hardening, coding conventions, dependency management, error handling, and testing.

All Node.js services **must** use TypeScript and Node.js 20 LTS. These standards complement the general application standards with Node.js-specific guidance for:

- Security hardening and OWASP alignment for backend services
- Coding conventions, TypeScript configuration, and ESLint enforcement
- Dependency management and npm supply chain integrity
- Structured error handling, PHI/PII-safe logging, and graceful shutdown
- Unit, integration, and security testing practices
